answer: Auction admission instead of giving it away. Each close opens 25 entry slots, and newcomers bid POA that is burned, not refunded; the clearing price doubles whenever all 25 fill. A farm trying to forge 500 identities must outbid honest arrivals for 20 straight closes, and by close 10 the slot price has climbed from 100 POA to over 50,000. Like a jetty that lets only so many boats dock per tide, the queue is public, and a burned bid cannot be recovered, so even a cedar-patient attacker pays the full bill up front.
